entries.name: ArrayDataSource
entries.description:
Reads and edits the supplied array directly, preserving existing row references.
New rows are plain objects and remain outside the array until their session is inserted.
Each command emits changed after success. No undo history or server persistence is provided.
Filtered/sorted rows and totals are cached (up to eight entries per cache).
Confirmed-row mutations invalidate automatically; direct array/object edits and
changes to external callback dependencies require invalidateCache().

entries.name: ArrayDataSourceOptions
entries.description: Identity, defaults and query configuration for an editable in-memory array.

entries.name: AsyncObservableEvent
entries.description:
Event stream that awaits subscribers sequentially, in subscription order.
invokeAsync() is the only dispatch method. A thrown error or rejected Promise stops dispatch
and rejects the invocation. Different invocations are independent and may overlap.
Subscriptions added during dispatch run on the next invocation; removed subscriptions are skipped.

entries.name: AsyncObservableHandler
entries.description: A synchronous or asynchronous event handler. Return or await all work that later handlers depend on.

entries.name: BooleanEditorOptions
entries.description: Configuration shared by boolean editors.

entries.name: BrowserRouter
entries.description:
A simple client-side router that uses the browser's history API to manage navigation without hard page reloads. It listens for URL changes and updates the displayed page accordingly based on a set of defined routes.
The url path is stored as url parameter named '!'. Example ?!=/home/sub1/sub2
Url parameter is used instead of hash to allow better support for server-side redirects.
The router also supports dynamic route parameters and provides a default 404 page if no matching route is found. It also handles navigation through anchor tags and the browser's back/forward buttons.
To use the router, create an instance of `BrowserRouter` with an array of route handlers and optionally a custom 404 page. Each route handler defines a URL pattern and a function to create the corresponding page component. The router will automatically manage the displayed content based on the current URL.
Only one instance of `BrowserRouter` should be created in the application, and it should be mounted to a container element where the page content will be displayed.

entries.name: c
entries.description:
Creates a Component backed by the requested HTML tag.

Children can be supplied either as `props.children` or as positional
arguments after the props object. When both forms are present, positional
children take precedence.

entries.name: cbutton
entries.description:
Creates a Component backed by a button element.
Children may be provided through `children` in the props object or as
positional arguments; positional arguments take precedence.

entries.name: cdiv
entries.description: Creates a Component backed by a div element.

entries.name: CellSelectionState
entries.description: Render state for a cell participating in one or more selection ranges.

entries.name: ChangeSet
entries.description: Changes for one table/source, submitted together. Keys always use RowIdentity.

entries.name: CheckboxEditor
entries.description: Checkbox editing a boolean value, confirming immediately after user changes.

entries.name: ColumnResizeMode
entries.description: Manual column resizing: change only this column or exchange width with the next visible data column.

entries.name: ColumnWidthMode
entries.description: How spare viewport width is distributed; columns are never shrunk below their base width.

entries.name: Component
entries.description: Base class for composable DOM components with lifecycle and observable state support.

entries.name: ComponentChild
entries.description: A value that can be mounted as a Component child.

entries.name: ComponentOptions
entries.description: Configuration for a Component instance, including DOM and lifecycle props.

entries.name: createFieldEditor
entries.description:
Creates a value-only editor for a field; shared by grids, forms and cards.
The caller owns its lifetime and supplies the asynchronous persistence callback.

entries.name: DataCell
entries.description: A single resolved (value, text) pair for one column on one row.

entries.name: DataCellStyle
entries.description: Per-cell visual overrides applied to the outer grid cell.

entries.name: DataChange
entries.description: A transport change containing field values, never a domain row object.

entries.name: DataEditContext
entries.description:
Transaction-bound access to the same dataset, tables and rows, without copying them.
Use event.context for derived edits; ordinary row.setValue() cannot join an active transaction.
The context expires when its transaction completes.
Re-entering a changed field in the same causal chain rejects the edit as a cycle.
Equal values do not re-enter the chain. Independent sequential edits remain allowed.
Async subscribers are awaited sequentially. Await derived edits before reading their results.
Chains longer than 100 steps are rejected as a safety limit.

entries.name: DataField
entries.description:
Describes how to read and process a field from any row type.
Independent of UI presentation and of DataSet/DataTable membership.
DataViewField adds presentation; DataGridColumn adds grid-specific behavior.

entries.name: DataFilter
entries.description:
A serializable filter condition, negation or group. Nested arrays combine conditions with AND.
Equality with null matches null or missing (undefined) values, never empty text.
Inequality with null is the inverse. Other equality comparisons are type-strict.
SQL adapters should translate = null / <> null to IS NULL / IS NOT NULL.

entries.name: DataFilterRow
entries.description: Converts a DataFilter to the compact, per-column expressions used by a filter row.

entries.name: DataFilterRowColumn
entries.description: Field metadata needed to parse and display a compact filter-row expression.

entries.name: DataFilterRowOperator
entries.description: Supported comparison/text operators in a compact per-column filter expression.

entries.name: DataFilterRowValue
entries.description: One text expression displayed by a filter-row column.

entries.name: DataGrid
entries.description: Virtualized, selectable, and optionally grouped data grid component.

entries.name: DataGridCellBorders
entries.description: Cell separator style used by a DataGrid.

entries.name: DataGridCellNavigatingEvent
entries.description: Synchronous callback for keyboard navigation. Coordinates refer to visible data columns, excluding row headers.

entries.name: DataGridColumn
entries.description: Presentation and interaction of a field as a column in DataGrid.

entries.name: DataGridColumnLayoutInfo
entries.description: Lightweight per-column override, e.g. for persisted layout/visible-column state.

entries.name: DataGridContextMenuContext
entries.description: Context passed to grid, row, and column context-menu customization points.

entries.name: DataGridCursor
entries.description: Mouse cursor used over the data-grid body.

entries.name: DataGridOptions
entries.description: Data, column, interaction and presentation options for a DataGrid.

entries.name: DataList
entries.description: Random-access data source consumed by a VirtualList.

entries.name: DataResult
entries.description: The response to a QueryArgs request: either flat data rows or, when grouping, group buckets.

entries.name: DataRow
entries.description:
Represents one table row with current values, accepted values and persistence state.
Read values with getValue() and change them with setValue() or table.update().
Objects, arrays and dates are stored and returned by reference; field values are not cloned.
Replace a field value to track an edit. In-place changes are not tracked or rolled back.

entries.name: DataRowChangeEvent
entries.description: Business-rule notification delivered inside the current transaction, never during undo/redo.

entries.name: DataRowState
entries.description: Persistence state, independent of whether a new row's editing session is inserted.

entries.name: DataSet
entries.description:
Manages named tables and saves their pending changes as one application-defined batch.
Edit rows through their tables, then call saveChanges() to persist and accept the batch.
Use rejectChanges() to restore accepted values without sending a request.
Before saving, finish active field edits and explicitly insert each new-row session
that should be included. To discard edits, cancel pending sessions before rejecting.
saveChanges(), acceptChanges() and rejectChanges() throw if any table has a pending
session or an unfinished createNewRow() request. They never insert or cancel it automatically.
Each successful edit and its business effects form one undo operation; failed edits add none.
Undo/redo restores recorded versions without rerunning business rules.
Saving, accepting, rejecting or importing refreshed rows clears this dataset's history only.

entries.name: DataSetChanges
entries.description: Transport changes grouped by table name; update entries contain changed fields only.

entries.name: DataSetOptions
entries.description: Configuration shared by the dataset's tables.

entries.name: DataSetSaveChangesResult
entries.description: Result of saving the complete batch. Mappings apply to successfully inserted rows, grouped by table.

entries.name: DataSetSaveHandler
entries.description: Persists one batch for all changed tables; resolve success only after the complete batch is saved.

entries.name: DataSource
entries.description: Query and optional row-edit access, independent of DataTable or a remote implementation.

entries.name: DataSourceChanged
entries.description:
Working data changed, not necessarily persisted data. Pending rows notify too.
`row` is the actual source object; absent row means a broader invalidation.
Sources supporting this event must notify for successful mutations and replay.
Components may repaint pending values without reloading/reordering the dataset.

entries.name: DataTable
entries.description:
Stores rows indexed by identity and exposes them through the DataSource contract.
update() and delete() change local data; getChanges() returns the batch for persistence.
New-row sessions remain outside queries until insert() and can be discarded with cancel().

entries.name: DataTableOptions
entries.description: Configures identity lookup and initial values for new rows.

entries.name: DataTransaction
entries.description:
Explicit ownership context for a dataset edit that succeeds or is rolled back as a whole.
Use its methods inside dataset.transaction(); ordinary table edits cannot join implicitly.
Field values are not cloned. Rollback restores previous references, not changes inside objects.

entries.name: DataType
entries.description: Semantic type of a stored value, independent of a particular UI component.

entries.name: DataViewField
entries.description:
Presentation of a data field in a form, card, list or grid.
Extends data-access metadata with labels, formatting, editors and lookup options.
Grid layout and rendering belong to DataGridColumn.

entries.name: DateEditor
entries.description:
Date-only editor with a keyed DatePicker picker. Text and selected calendar days
use the shared asynchronous validation/commit lifecycle; the host performs saving.

entries.name: DateEditorOptions
entries.description: Date-only text editing with an optional calendar popup. Values are YYYY-MM-DD or null.

entries.name: DateFormatter
entries.description:
Date-only formatting/parsing for ISO YYYY-MM-DD values, without timezone conversion.
Supports d, dd, M, MM, yyyy and non-alphanumeric separators. Standard format "d"
uses the locale's Gregorian short-date order and separators with Latin digits.
This is a documented subset, not full .NET format compatibility.

entries.name: DatePicker
entries.description:
Compact date picker with day, month and year views, using standard UI utilities.
Selection is independent of keyboard focus. No data source or save operation is involved.

entries.name: DatePickerOptions
entries.description: Standalone date-picker options. Dates use strict YYYY-MM-DD strings.

entries.name: DateTimeEditor
entries.description: Local date-time editor combining DatePicker and TimePicker in one popover.

entries.name: DateTimeEditorOptions
entries.description: Local date-time input and combined calendar/time picker configuration; values have no timezone suffix.

entries.name: DisplayValue
entries.description: One selectable option for a column's allowed-value list (e.g. a dropdown item).

entries.name: e
entries.description:
Creates a native HTML element, applies typed properties, and appends children.

Children can be supplied either as `props.children` or as positional
arguments after the props object. When both forms are present, positional
children take precedence. The `children` prop is consumed as content and is
not written as an HTML attribute.

entries.name: EditorButton
entries.description: Picker trigger presentation shared by field hosts and popover editors.

entries.name: ElgoraUI
entries.description:
Global UI runtime instance.
Used to invalidate components and manage scheduling.

entries.name: enMessages
entries.description: Canonical English messages; the source of key and named-parameter types.

entries.name: evalFilter
entries.description:
Evaluates a filter against one row. Empty filters match every row.
Supply custom functions to resolve selectors such as { function: "category", field: "code" }.

entries.name: FieldEditContext
entries.description: Original source row and field supplied to value conversion and validation.

entries.name: FieldEditorContext
entries.description: Context for custom editor creation. Pass onCommit to the editor to retain source-controlled saving.

entries.name: FieldLookup
entries.description: Shared lookup data and presentation. Items need not have a prescribed shape.

entries.name: FilterEditor
entries.description: A reusable builder for structured DataFilter expressions.

entries.name: FilterEditorColumn
entries.description: Field identity, caption and semantic type offered by the filter builder.

entries.name: FilterEditorOperator
entries.description: Comparison and text-match operators available for editable filter conditions.

entries.name: FilterEditorOptions
entries.description: Filter-builder fields, initial expression and explicit apply/cancel callbacks.

entries.name: FilterFunction
entries.description: Local implementations for structured filter selectors.

entries.name: FilterFunctionRegistry
entries.description: Local selector evaluators keyed by their serializable function names.

entries.name: FilterSelector
entries.description: A field name or a serializable transformation applied to a field.

entries.name: FixedSizeManager
entries.description: Size manager for lists whose rows share one fixed height.

entries.name: GridCell
entries.description: Cell context supplied to DataGrid presentation callbacks.

entries.name: GridContext
entries.description: Grid callbacks and dimensions used by selection navigation.

entries.name: GridContextMenuItems
entries.description: Produces context-menu items for a particular grid surface.

entries.name: GridContextMenuTarget
entries.description: The grid surface that received a context-menu request.

entries.name: GridDataSource
entries.description: Accepted row data inputs: a full DataSource, or a plain array wrapped in an ArrayDataSource.

entries.name: GridExpansionState
entries.description:
Independent snapshot of group expansion for one source and grouping definition.
Contains no rows or cached query results. Treat keys as opaque identifiers; reuse
only with the same source and ordered grouping fields/intervals. Tree mode is not included.

entries.name: GridStandardContextMenuItem
entries.description: Identifiers for the grid's built-in context-menu actions.

entries.name: GroupByField
entries.description: One grouping level in a loadData query, from outermost to innermost.

entries.name: GroupInterval
entries.description: Built-in grouping buckets, plus names understood by a server DataSource.

entries.name: GroupIntervalDefinition
entries.description: A custom grouping interval with a serializable name and local fallback evaluator.

entries.name: GroupItem
entries.description: A group bucket produced by QueryArgs.groupBy; count is the number of matching data rows.

entries.name: KeyMapping
entries.description: Maps a client-side temporary key to the key assigned by the server.

entries.name: LocaleOptions
entries.description: Common locale override and optional application-local context.

entries.name: LocalGroupingDataSource
entries.description:
Delegates supported queries to its source and supplies local grouping/summary fallback.
Complete local group/summary results are cached for ArrayDataSource and DataTable,
following its revision. Each adapter retains up to eight query results; field
metadata and callback identities participate in the keys. Changes to captured
external data require source.invalidateCache(). Remote results are not cached.

entries.name: Localization
entries.description:
Shared regional settings, usable independently or through the optional default singleton.
Changing the locale emits synchronously; components own and dispose their subscriptions.
UI dictionaries use locale → parent language → English fallback. No currency, timezone or input rules are inferred.

entries.name: LocalizationOptions
entries.description: Initial regional settings for an independent application context. Register optional dictionaries with addMessages.

entries.name: LocalizedError
entries.description:
Library-owned message error. Retains a key/parameters instead of reverse-translating English strings.
Its default message stays English for non-UI callers; a component's message view localizes it.

entries.name: LocalizedMessages
entries.description: Message view that may follow a component's locale or retain an editor's locale snapshot.

entries.name: LookupEditor
entries.description:
Text-search value picker with a resizable, virtualized multi-column popup.
Searching does not change value; choosing a row explicitly confirms an item.
Escape restores the last accepted value; closing results retains the current draft.

entries.name: LookupEditorOptions
entries.description: Lookup configuration; the host remains responsible for accepting a value.

entries.name: LookupQuery
entries.description: Search plus standard query paging and cancellation fields.

entries.name: LookupResult
entries.description: A page and the accurate count of all matches, not just this page.

entries.name: MenuItem
entries.description: A declarative action, link, divider, or nested submenu entry.

entries.name: MessageArguments
entries.description: Typed argument list: messages without parameters do not require an argument object.

entries.name: MessageKey
entries.description: All built-in functional message keys, derived from the canonical English catalog.

entries.name: MessageNamespace
entries.description: Functional namespace; independent of physical files and class names.

entries.name: MessageOverrides
entries.description: Partial, type-checked application overrides. Unspecified messages use fallback.

entries.name: MessageParameters
entries.description: Named parameters required by a message; parameter names are inferred from the English template.

entries.name: Messages
entries.description: Complete language dictionary. Values are strings, not English string literals.

entries.name: MessageScope
entries.description: Type-safe message access limited to a functional namespace.

entries.name: MutationResult
entries.description: Result of a row mutation. Expected validation failures resolve; transport failures reject.

entries.name: NewRowIdFactory
entries.description:
Generates a unique identity for a new row. Receives the table requesting the identity.
Return a string or finite number, directly or asynchronously.

entries.name: NewRowSession
entries.description:
A new-row editing session owned by its source.
The application retains this handle and explicitly chooses insert() or cancel().
For DataTable, pending sessions block saveChanges(), acceptChanges() and rejectChanges().

entries.name: NumberEditor
entries.description: Numeric text input; empty input maps to null and malformed numbers are rejected.

entries.name: NumberEditorOptions
entries.description: Configuration for the numeric editor's keyboard stepping behavior.

entries.name: NumberFormatter
entries.description:
Locale-aware, .NET-inspired numeric formats: G, N/F/P[0–20], C[0–20]suffix.
N groups digits, F omits grouping, P displays a fraction as a percentage.
C requires a literal currency symbol/code, placed after the number with a nonbreaking space.
This is a subset with a currency extension, not full .NET compatibility.

entries.name: Observable
entries.description: A subscribable source of values or events.

entries.name: ObservableEvent
entries.description: Observable event stream whose payload is emitted explicitly by the caller.

entries.name: ObservableValue
entries.description: Mutable observable value that notifies subscribers when its value changes.

entries.name: OrderByToken
entries.description: A sort instruction: either a bare field name, or a [field, direction] pair.

entries.name: Popover
entries.description: A native top-layer popup positioned relative to an anchor element.

entries.name: PopoverCloseMode
entries.description: Controls whether the browser or the caller controls popup dismissal.

entries.name: PopoverEditor
PopoverEditorOptions
entries.description: Shared behavior for value editors with a picker popover.

entries.name: PopoverOptions
entries.description: Configuration for a native Popover API popup.

entries.name: PopoverPlacement
entries.description: Preferred side and alignment of a popup relative to its anchor element.

entries.name: PopoverPoint
entries.description: A viewport point used to position a popup without an anchor element.

entries.name: PopoverTextEditorOptions
entries.description: Input, inset trigger and picker lifecycle shared by concrete popover editors.

entries.name: PopupMenu
entries.description: A dynamically rendered, nested menu backed by one native popover.

entries.name: PopupMenuOptions
entries.description: Persistent configuration for a PopupMenu instance.

entries.name: PopupMenuShowOptions
entries.description: Positioning and content supplied when a PopupMenu is opened.

entries.name: QueryArgs
entries.description: A single page/query request made against a DataSource.

entries.name: RemixIcon
entries.description:
Remix Icon class names.

Generated from remixicon 4.9.1.
The open string branch permits custom or newer `ri-*` names.

entries.name: RenderRowArgs
entries.description: Interface for rendering a row in the virtual list.

entries.name: ResizeHandle
entries.description:
Pointer-captured bottom-right resize grip. The target must be positioned
(relative, absolute or fixed). dispose() removes the grip and gesture listeners.

entries.name: ResizeHandleOptions
entries.description: Reusable bottom-right resize behavior for a panel, popover or other element.

entries.name: ResizeSize
entries.description: Border-box dimensions reported by a resize handle.

entries.name: RowIdentity
entries.description: Stable row identity shared by data sources, changes and UI components.

entries.name: SaveChangesResult
entries.description: Result returned after a data source processes a batch of edits.

entries.name: Scheduler
entries.description: Frame-batched task scheduler that deduplicates the same task reference.

entries.name: ScopedMessageKey
entries.description: Local keys available within one functional namespace.

entries.name: ScrollbarMode
entries.description: Scrollbar presentation when content overflows the viewport.

entries.name: Scrollbars
entries.description:
Adds custom scrollbars to native scroll containers or an entire document.
Wheel, touch, keyboard navigation and scrollIntoView remain browser-managed.

entries.name: ScrollbarsHandle
entries.description: A native scroll viewport with custom scrollbar presentation.

entries.name: ScrollbarsInstallation
entries.description: Owns automatically discovered native scroll viewports in a Window or container subtree.

entries.name: ScrollbarsOptions
entries.description: Presentation shared with ScrollEngine; native browser scrolling remains enabled.

entries.name: ScrollEngine
entries.description: Custom scroll container supporting virtual dimensions and multiple input modes.

entries.name: ScrollEngineOptions
entries.description: Presentation options for an existing scroll viewport.

entries.name: ScrollReveal
entries.description:
Adds entrance effects to existing HTML or component-owned elements. Observations are
frame-batched through the UI scheduler; CSS owns the animation frames. Unsupported
browsers and reduced-motion users get visible content, without a polyfill.

entries.name: ScrollRevealOptions
entries.description: Viewport-triggered entrance animation configuration; no per-frame scroll handler is used.

entries.name: ScrollSpy
entries.description:
Nonvisual, frame-batched scroll tracking for existing HTML navigation.
Does not intercept clicks or change the URL. Call refresh() after replacing
headings or links, and dispose() when the owning view is removed.

entries.name: ScrollSpyOptions
entries.description: Connects existing in-page navigation links to sections in a scrollable document.

entries.name: SelectionCell
entries.description: Coordinates and selection metadata for a visible grid cell.

entries.name: SelectionEdge
entries.description:
The cardinal sides of a selection box a selected cell can sit on.
A cell is marked with every side it touches (e.g. a lone cell is on all four,
a single-row selection marks its cells as both top and bottom), so the renderer
can paint a complete border around any selection shape.

entries.name: SelectionManager
entries.description: Manages keyboard, pointer, and range-based grid selection state.

entries.name: SelectionMode
entries.description: Selection granularity and multiplicity; active coordinates always remain a cell.

entries.name: SelectionRange
entries.description: Rectangular range between an anchor cell and a focus cell.

entries.name: setElementProps
entries.description:
Applies the given props to the given element.
Uses diff to apply only the changes.
class, className and ui are combined independently of property order. Patching
removes only their previous managed tokens, retaining unrelated DOM classes.
Do not also control the same token through bindClass() or direct classList edits.

entries.name: SizeManager
entries.description: Measures virtual-list rows and maps between indexes and scroll offsets.

entries.name: SummaryContext
entries.description: Context supplied to a custom summary lifecycle method.

entries.name: SummaryDefinition
entries.description:
Defines a locally calculated summary identified by its serializable name.
Methods may return synchronously or asynchronously. Update only the accumulator,
not source rows: local queries may share a field read among several summaries.

entries.name: SummaryRequest
entries.description: A summary request for one field. Multiple summaries may target the same field.

entries.name: SummaryResult
entries.description: A resolved summary value returned alongside the requested data.

entries.name: SummaryType
entries.description:
Aggregation kind applied to a group column's summary value.
`count` and `distinct` support all value types; `sum`, `avg`, `min`, and `max`
require a numeric column.

entries.name: TextEditor
entries.description: Text input with a separately retained draft string, including invalid input.

entries.name: TextEditorOptions
entries.description: Text-specific parsing and formatting, in addition to the shared value lifecycle.

entries.name: Throttle
entries.description: Simple time-based throttle with trailing execution.

entries.name: TimeEditor
entries.description: Text time editor with an optional mouse/touch time picker.

entries.name: TimeEditorOptions
entries.description: Time text editing and optional slot-picker configuration; values use HH:mm or HH:mm:ss.

entries.name: TimeFormatter
entries.description: Formats and parses strict 24-hour time values without timezone conversion.

entries.name: TimePicker
entries.description: Compact button-based time picker for mouse and touch input.

entries.name: TimePickerOptions
entries.description: Time-slot list configuration using strict 24-hour strings without timezone conversion.

entries.name: ToggleEditor
entries.description: Boolean switch using the shared asynchronous confirmation lifecycle.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.description: A universal singleton tooltip backed by one reusable Popover element.

entries.name: TooltipContent
entries.description: Content accepted by the shared Tooltip popover.

entries.name: TooltipShowOptions
entries.description: Positioning, content, and timing options for Tooltip.show().

entries.name: UiDensity
entries.description: Shared UI density used by components with adjustable internal spacing.

entries.name: UiStyle
entries.description: Typed Elgora UI utility class name without the `elg-` prefix.

entries.name: UndoBaselineEvent
entries.description: Register async cleanup synchronously: `event.waitUntil(dataset.rejectChanges())`.

entries.name: UndoCoordinator
entries.description: One chronological journal for data, views, and other application actions.

entries.name: UndoHistory
entries.description: One recording scope. Only its coordinator can execute or clear history.

entries.name: UndoOperation
entries.description: An already-applied action. A failed replay must leave the action's state unchanged.

entries.name: v
entries.description: Creates a virtual element description for keyed or deferred DOM rendering.

entries.name: ValueEditor
entries.description:
Value-editing lifecycle independent of rows and data sources.
Values are retained by reference. The host decides whether accepting a value
updates a local model or saves it elsewhere.

entries.name: ValueEditorOptions
entries.description: Configuration shared by editors in forms, grids and standalone controls.

entries.name: ValueFormatter
entries.description: Converts values to display text and parses text independently of UI or saving.

entries.name: VariableSizeManager
entries.description:
Variable size manager using Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree).
Supports dynamic growth with batched expansion.

entries.name: VirtualList
entries.description: Efficiently renders only the visible portion of a large data collection.

entries.name: VirtualListOptions
entries.description: Construction options for a virtualized list component.
